headline_marked: [[Claude Code]] Now Uses Bun Written in Rust, Startup 10% Faster
headline: Claude Code Now Uses Bun Written in Rust, Startup 10% Faster
summary: The AI coding assistant Claude Code has quietly integrated Bun's Rust-based runtime, leading to a 10% speed improvement on Linux for startups.
details: Claude Code v2.1.181 and later versions are now utilizing Bun, the JavaScript runtime, which has been rewritten in Rust. This subtle but significant change was implemented by Jarred Sumner.

The integration has resulted in a noticeable performance boost, with startups experiencing a 10% faster startup time on Linux. However, the change has otherwise gone largely unnoticed by users, which Sumner describes as "boring is good."

Initial checks confirmed that Claude Code installations were running Bun v1.4.0 on macOS arm64. This version number suggests the use of a preview of an upcoming Bun release, as the latest official GitHub release was v1.3.14.
The Rust version of Bun has since been officially released as 'Bun canary'. Users can install this release by running the command `bun upgrade --canary`.
This adoption indicates that Bun's Rust implementation is now running in production on millions of devices, a testament to its stability and performance gains.
caption:

Initial checks confirmed that Claude Code installations were running Bun v1.4.0 on macOS arm64. This version number suggests the use of a preview of an upcoming Bun release, as the latest official GitHub release was v1.3.14.

The Rust version of Bun has since been officially released as 'Bun canary'. Users can install this release by running the command `bun upgrade --canary`.

headline_marked: Qwen Releases [[Qwen3.8-Max-Preview]] AI Model with Unified Access Plan
headline: Qwen Releases Qwen3.8-Max-Preview AI Model with Unified Access Plan
summary: New Qwen Cloud offers a single plan for text, vision, speech, and image generation models, now more affordable for individuals and teams.
details: Qwen has launched its latest AI model, Qwen3.8-Max-Preview, making advanced AI capabilities more accessible. The new offering includes more affordable Individual and Team Plans, allowing users to leverage powerful models for their projects.

A key feature of the Qwen Cloud is its unified Token Plan, which provides access to a suite of leading models. This includes text, vision, speech, and image generation capabilities, streamlining the AI development process.

Developers can now save settings and begin coding directly with Qwen Cloud via Qwen Code. The platform is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing workflows, supporting mainstream tools that are compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic protocols.
